title: Training evidence – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Training evidence
hero.lead: Coaches use training evidence to assign running or training tasks to players. Players submit a document or a Strava activity as evidence. Coaches track progress and review submitted documents.

body:
Open the area

  1. Open Team & club in the main navigation.
  2. Select Training evidence at the top.
  3. If you are assigned to several teams, select the required team first.

The arrow at the top right collapses or expands the entire area. Kaderblick remembers this setting and, for coaches, the most recently used grouping by runs or players.

Status, filters and search

  • Open contains released tasks with outstanding submissions, including overdue tasks.
  • Scheduled contains tasks whose Available from date has not yet been reached.
  • Completed contains fully completed tasks.
  • Archive contains tasks archived by a coach.
  • Player limits the list to one person. From and To filter by the relevant task date.
  • Once tasks exist, the search field searches titles and player names.

Create training evidence

This function is available to people who are permitted to manage the team’s training evidence.

  1. Select Add training evidence.
  2. Enter a clear title. The task cannot be created without one.
  3. For a running task, enter the required distance in kilometres.
  4. Use Available from to specify when submissions may begin and Due by for the deadline.
  5. Select individual players under Recipients. If the selection remains empty, Kaderblick assigns the task to all players currently included.
  6. Add an optional description and select Create.

Your task: submit a document

  1. Open a task with open status.
  2. Select the button with the file icon.
  3. Select the evidence file in the upload area and complete the upload.
  4. After submission, the card shows the uploaded document’s name.

Submission actions are disabled for scheduled, completed or archived tasks.

Your task: submit a Strava activity

  1. Connect Strava under My profile if it is not already connected.
  2. Select Submit with Strava on the open task.
  3. Select the relevant activity in the dialogue. Depending on the available Strava data, Kaderblick shows distance, moving time, date and average heart rate.
  4. Select Send beside the activity.

The imported activity values appear directly on the task after submission.

Coach view: monitor progress

Four figures above the list summarise the current selection: submitted versus expected evidence, missing submissions, tasks due soon and fully completed tasks.

  • By runs groups by task. Each card shows the title, distance or evidence type, deadline, progress bar and missing players.
  • By players groups people under No submission, Partly completed and Complete. Use Show all to display complete players.
  • Details opens the Missing, Submitted and, where applicable, Excused lists within a task.
  • For a submitted document, Review document opens the file read-only. Strava evidence shows the imported activity values.

Excuse a player

  1. Select a missing player in the coach view. In the By players grouping, use the excuse icon.
  2. Choose whether the excuse applies only to the selected tasks or to all open tasks.
  3. Select Illness, Holiday, Injury, Not in team or Other as the reason.
  4. Add an optional note and confirm with Excuse.

In the Excused details tab, the X beside a player removes the excuse for that task.

Archive and reactivate

Archive moves a task to the Archive tab. Reactivate restores it there. Archiving does not delete the task or its submissions.

Differences by role and relation

  • Coaches and other authorised team managers: see the control view, totals, both groupings, and review, excuse and archive actions.
  • Players: see only tasks assigned to them and submit their own evidence.
  • Parents and other player relations: receive only the content Kaderblick releases for the relevant relation and team.
  • Club roles without this permission and supporters: do not receive coach actions solely because of their club or supporter role.

Related areas

  • The team and squad come from Clubs & teams.
  • The Strava connection is managed under My profile.
  • Uploaded evidence uses the relevant player’s document function.
